questions.prompt: Find k if x = 2 is a zero of x² + kx − 10.
The height of a ball is h(t) = 20t − 5t² metres after t seconds. Find h(2) and the zeros of h(t), and explain what they mean.
questions.modelAnswer: h(2) = 40 − 20 = 20 m: the ball is 20 m high after 2 s. Zeros: 20t − 5t² = 5t(4 − t) = 0, so t = 0 or t = 4. The ball is at ground level when thrown (t = 0) and lands again after 4 s.
rubric: Interprets zeros as launch and landing
questions.explain: Criterion D: interpreting a polynomial model.
